items.title: Wabash National pays $50,000 to settle EEOC pregnancy discrimination suit
items.summary: Commercial trucking equipment producer Wabash National agreed to pay $50,000 and provide relief to settle a pregnancy discrimination lawsuit brought by the EEOC.

items.title: Hiscox updates return estimates for Syndicate 33 and Syndicate 6104
items.summary: Specialist insurer Hiscox has released revised return estimates for the 2024 and 2025 accounts of Syndicate 33 and Syndicate 6104.

items.title: Former Hiscox CEO Bronek Masojada assumes role as Lord Mayor of London
items.summary: Bronek Masojada has taken office as the Lord Mayor of London, focusing on boosting UK economic growth and pension fund investments.

items.title: Aviva general insurance premiums rise 19% to £11.8bn in first nine months of 2026
items.summary: Aviva reports a 19% increase in general insurance premiums to £11.8 billion for the first nine months of 2026 alongside an improved combined operating ratio of 93.8%.

items.title: FCA warns public over unauthorised clone firm CheapCuva
items.summary: The Financial Conduct Authority has issued a warning against an unauthorized entity operating under the name CheapCuva, which is impersonating legitimate provider Cuvva Limited.

items.title: Aviva reports rise in subsidence claims following hot summer
items.summary: Aviva and other UK insurers have experienced a surge in domestic subsidence claims following record summer temperatures.
